hero.label: Made for Vooma
hero.headline: I'll help Vooma build a phone heavy outbound engine that actually scales.
hero.subheadline: I spent a year as a BDR at Copygen.ai building pipeline from zero, and I like high volume outbound. Vooma needs someone who can cold call logistics operators, test messaging fast, and use AI tools to compound output. That's the part I enjoy.

whyCompany.title: Phone heavy fits me
whyCompany.body: Vooma explicitly wants someone who loves the phone. At Copygen.ai I lived in outbound, handled cold outreach every day, and learned that consistent activity only matters if the messaging keeps improving.

whyCompany.title: I like building the system, not just running it
whyCompany.body: The role is not just dialing. It is building process, experiments, cadences, and feedback loops. I have already deployed OpenClaw AI agents, including an automated BDR system, so the idea of combining hustle with automation is natural for me.

whyCompany.title: Founder market fit is obvious here
whyCompany.body: Jesse grew a logistics software business from $2M to $20M+ ARR and Mike built self driving trucks at Kodiak and Uber ATG. That kind of founder background matters. It makes me confident Vooma is solving a real workflow pain, not chasing AI hype.

quote: I would be excited to help Vooma win the unglamorous work, more calls, better targeting, faster feedback, and a cleaner outbound machine.
